problems.source_claim_scope: Lemma 2.14 at its explicitly included k2=2 boundary, using its own compact-type and real-similitude conventions.
problems.independent_reasoning: At k2=2, source (2.3)-(2.6) give V0=V1 and V2=V3. The first Hom table assigns different dimensions to the identical j=0 spaces for i=0 and i=1. The concrete (k1,k2,m)=(2,2,-2), lambda=(1,0), satisfies weight/parity and has multiplicity-one minimal compact type (2,2), as the appendix's boundary and pairing conventions confirm; no global arithmetic realization is needed. For all k>=2 the displayed Clebsch-Gordan summands follow by tensoring E_(k,2) and E_(1,3-k) with exterior highest weights (0,0),(0,-2),(-1,-3),(-3,-3). Central-weight bounds leave only A,j=0 and B,j=3 for the paired holomorphic representation. For the generic component, the partition multiplicity vanishes for first weight below k, and at first weight k is one precisely for second weight 0,-2,-4,... . Directly applying this and reflected weights (-s,-r) to every finite summand leaves only A,j=1 and B,j=2. Thus the entire replacement table, not just the contradiction, follows.
problems.counterevidence_and_impact: Each component cochain complex has one nonzero degree, so its differentials vanish. Repeated bundles have the intended degrees 0/1 and 2/3 already stated by Corollary 2.17. This local indexing correction preserves the central boundary cohomology; Minor is correctly scoped.

problems.verdict: Conditional calculation confirmed; arithmetic realization remains unproved
problems.source_claim_scope: Critical-integer list of Lemma 3.6 for the actual displayed Gamma factor, under lambda1>lambda2>=0 and odd w. The retained primary evidence does not establish all proposed X35 hypotheses.
problems.independent_reasoning: At integral n the four complex Gamma factors are regular exactly when n>=M+1, M=max(lambda1,2lambda2). Applying the dual argument 2w+1-n gives n<=2w-M. The real Gamma factor at n and at the dual argument excludes even n<=w-1 and odd n>=w+2. The remaining range is odd integers [M+1,w] union even integers [w+1,2w-M]. For (34,33), the printed n=35 produces Gamma_C(-31), whereas exactly 67 and 68 survive. This is an exact conditional pole calculation, independent of any finite-grid computation. For lambda2>0, M<=w-1, so w,w+1 survive; lambda2=0 yields an empty range.
problems.counterevidence_and_impact: The report correctly does not claim the numerical pair is a fully verified automorphic witness. Primary pages for normalization/rational coefficients, Hecke eigenform status and applicability are missing; historical attributions are not current verification. The existence criterion and the central (k,2) case survive. Needs Evidence is retained, not promoted to an established mathematical counterexample.
